deposit.pageDescription: Enter the information below to initiate a deposit request to your wallet via Mobile Money or bank transfer.
deposit.securityNotice: You will receive a notification on your phone to confirm this payment. No amount will be debited without your validation.
deposit.accountHolderPlaceholder: Full name of the account holder
deposit.errorGeneric: An error occurred while initiating the payment.

processing.descriptionMobile: We are verifying your payment with Campay and your operator. Please wait a few moments.
processing.successMessage: Payment confirmed! Your wallet has been credited.
processing.failedMessage: Payment failed. You will be redirected.
processing.ussdBannerDescription: A notification has appeared on your phone. Please confirm the payment by dialing the USSD code.
processing.infoBank: Do not close this page. Bank verification may take a few minutes.
processing.infoMobile: Do not close this page. Confirmation may take a few seconds.
processing.errorGeneric: An error occurred while verifying the payment.

requestSent.descriptionMobile: Your deposit request has been successfully sent to your phone. Please confirm the payment to complete the transaction.
requestSent.infoBank: Make a bank transfer using the information displayed above. Credit will be automatic upon confirmed receipt by your bank.
requestSent.infoMobile: There is nothing you need to do for now. Please check your phone and confirm the Mobile Money payment.

wallet.depositSuccessDescription: Your deposit has been confirmed and the amount has been credited to your wallet.
